name: Disk Vigil
description: Settle into a wide low stance with a ring in each hand and the weight held in the hollow between.

name: Galvanizing Roundedge
description: Read the open sky and the foe's shoulder together to pick the moment for the paired throw.

name: Rumble Bladering
description: Skim two rings low across the ground so they rise together under the target's guard.

name: Devastating Spinrim
description: Throw the rings in two high arcs so both drop behind the cover the foe has chosen.

name: Gust Fingerhole
description: Meet a thrust with both rims moving as mirror images so the point is pushed to either side.

name: Merciless Outerblade
description: Surge both rings out from the basin stance in rapid alternation to hold a foe pinned.

name: Downpour Graze
description: Cast paired rings high and bring them down together on a wide front like the sky closing.

name: Unassailable Outerblade
description: Spin both rings before the body so thrown blades strike the rims and are sent back at the thrower.

name: Slag Innergrip
description: Send two great rings in opposite circles around a field of foes and close them inward together.

name: Nimbus Hoopedge
description: Lock the gaze on one spot of the foe's body and wait unmoving until the guard drops there.

name: Rumble Ricochet
description: Pitch a ring from each hand on level lines so they meet at the same height on the target.

name: Impervious Holeedge
description: Spread both arms wide with a ring held in each to cover the flanks like open wings.

name: Grazeglare
description: Land from a leap on the balls of both feet so the rings stay still in the hands.

name: Facet Whirlcut
description: Throw one ring up and over so it stoops steeply on the foe from above.

name: Webbing Innergrip
description: Throw one ring openly and a second hidden behind it so the foe guards the wrong track.

name: Murk Ringface
description: Snatch a foe's thrown ring from the air by its rim and spin it straight back.

name: Booming Gyrate
description: Drop both rings from height along two tracks that meet in the target's chest.

name: Chimebounce
description: Throw a wide pair across the foe's approach so he must break stride or be cut.

name: Glintdisk
description: Vanish from the foe's front in a burst of speed and reappear at his flank with both rings already cutting.

name: Prescient Hoopedge
description: Open with a formal salute of both rings that shows the foe's stance while hiding your own grip.

name: Elevating Fingerhole
description: Circle each ring slowly around its hand until the rim hums evenly at a steady pitch.

name: Decimating Gyrate
description: Throw two rings level in opposing directions so each circles round the foe and returns.

name: Thorn Holeedge
description: Sweep both rings up and out like wings to take a cut on the lower rims.

name: Meteoric Ricochet
description: Retreat in slow measured paces with both rings turned outward so the foe cannot close.

name: Toxingyrate
description: Loop a circling rim round the foe's weapon arm so the stroke is pulled short.

name: Booming Bladering
description: Throw from two angles at once so the foe stands in a crossfire of rims.

name: Aura Bounce
description: Pass the ring in a river-bend loop over the guard and down across the shoulder.

name: Punishing Carom
description: Keep both rims circling in widening loops about the thrower to cut every foe who closes in.

name: Hollowround
description: Judge the foe's guard and send both rims through its weakest point in one decided cut.

name: Punishing Graze
description: Spin both rings in one vast circle that cuts approaching foes and bars their path at once.

name: Verity Spinrim
description: Tune the two rings to the same spin by listening until their whirs match in pitch.

name: Caromruin
description: Bank the body like a turning hawk and loose a ring from the lowest point of the turn.

name: Vital Roundedge
description: Breathe to the pace of the spinning rings so their speed and the lungs rise together.

name: Ruinous Ringface
description: Pass a spinning ring from hand to hand without breaking its orbit and throw it from the receiving hand.

name: Chime Hoopedge
description: Catch a blade in the meeting point of two orbiting rims and fling it clear.

name: Mayhemgyrate
description: Sweep both rings out in a broad flat arc that forces nearby foes to leap or fall back.

name: Silt Ringface
description: Plant a qi-spun ring across the foe's path so it cuts whoever walks into it.

name: Brutalizing Spinrim
description: Rebound one ring off the other in mid-air so the two change course together toward a second target.

name: Eviscerating Carom
description: Whirl both rings so their orbits interlock then drive the knot of spinning rims through a guard in one stroke.

name: Vital Innergrip
description: Hold the ring upright between thumb and finger like a wheel poised to roll.

name: Energizing Bladering
description: Spin the ring upright on a flat stone to hear whether its rim runs true.

name: Chime Gyrate
description: Send two upright rings down two tracks a body-width apart so they roll through the foe's line.

name: Aegis Outerblade
description: Turn the whole body with a ring before it like water turning round a standing stone.

name: Gustgraze
description: Weave between two foes with short flowing steps while the rings stay close to the body.

name: Roundruin
description: Cut with the ring turned like a wheel's spoke and rim leading along the foe's guard arm.

name: Hoopruin
description: Cross two upright rings in flight so they meet and bite at one point on the target.

name: Adamantine Outerblade
description: Slip a blade down the dished face of the ring and out past the hip.

name: Granite Ricochet
description: Retreat in a river's bend and throw as the foe overreaches into the space you left.

name: Diskhavoc
description: Roll a ring along the ground into the foe's legs and cut upward as it rises.

name: Fastening Disk
description: Pin the foe's weapon arm between two crossing rims and hold it fast while the second ring strikes.

name: Daybreak Holeedge
description: Whirl both rings into one great wheel and cast it across the front to overturn the whole line.

name: Remnant Fingerhole
description: Weigh the two heavy rims in the hands to feel which is a shade the heavier.

name: Ferocious Carom
description: Throw both heavy rings slowly and deliberately so each carries its full weight to the mark.

name: Indomitable Holeedge
description: Brace both forearms together with the heavy rims laid across them against a crushing blow.

name: Meridian Fingerhole
description: Advance in short measured steps that keep the heavy rims level and the shoulders square.

name: Irondisk
description: Swing a heavy rim down in a chopping cut that bites deep into a raised guard.

name: Gyrate Spine
description: Throw one ring to pin the foe's blade aside and the other to strike the opened side.

name: Chime Disk
description: Cross both heavy rims in front of the chest to turn a charging thrust wide.

name: Lancing Disk
description: Drive both rims forward edge to edge like a lance's head to split a shield.

name: Bouncedurance
description: Throw both rims in crossing spirals so they tangle the foe's arms against his body.

name: Brutalizing Bounce
description: Gather the whole reserve into two rims thrown as one and send them through the guard of a stronger foe.

name: Perceptive Ringface
description: Hold the ring up to the wind before the throw and read its push on the rim.

name: Auragyrate
description: Murmur the sworn words and pitch the ring on the last syllable.

name: Invincible Hoopedge
description: Plant the feet against a hard gust and hold the ring across the chest.

name: Siltbounce
description: Stride long and level over open ground with the ring arm swinging free of the body.

name: Chime Innergrip
description: Release as a gust peaks so the ring rises on the wind and falls steeply on the foe.

name: Unrelenting Bladering
description: Meet a cut with the ring's rim at the instant of an exhale and sweep it away.

name: Facet Spinrim
description: Throw upwind of the foe so the ring banks on the wind and returns onto his lee side.

name: Ruinous Gyrate
description: Throw ring after ring on the wind while keeping the oath unbroken so the volley never falters.

name: Slag Bounce
description: Cast a ring along the plateau's open line so it sweeps every foe standing on that bearing.

name: Glint Roundedge
description: Turn a ranged attack aside with the ring's rim and send it back along the same bearing.

name: Healing Fingerhole
description: Fix the eye on a mark at the edge of sight and hold it through the whole motion.

name: Carom Reckoning
description: Sling the ring low and far from the hip so it flies a long flat line.

name: Unbudging Roundedge
description: Dig in the heels and lean into a gust with the ring held low across the thigh.

name: Hoarfrost Bladering
description: Hold the bearing a heartbeat after release so the arm follows the ring's line.

name: Hoarfrost Spinrim
description: Throw sidearm so the crosswind curls the ring in from the far side of the mark.

name: Unassailable Holeedge
description: Turn into a gust as the blade comes and use its push to carry the blow wide.

name: Nimbusdisk
description: Sweep a held bearing across the whole open plateau with a great throw that clears a broad front.

name: Glintcarom
description: Cast at a target at the very limit of sight and hold the bearing until the ring falls on it.

name: Eviscerating Roundedge
description: Wind the whole body into the cast on a far horizon so the ring passes through a foe at the end of its flight.

name: Aura Hoopedge
description: Listen to the pitch of the ring's whir in the gale to hear how well it rides.

name: Ricochet Devastation
description: Open the grip at the top of a gust so the wind takes the ring without a push.

name: Invincible Ringface
description: Drop the leeward shoulder and cover it with the ring arm against a low cut.

name: Graze Whirlpool
description: Slide the feet along the ground with the wind at the shoulder to cover distance quickly.

name: Equipoise Spinrim
description: Roll the wrist loosely in the moving air until the joint swings without effort.

name: Nimbusround
description: Lob the ring into a strong updraft so it climbs far then falls onto a distant foe.

name: Mayhemround
description: Strike the ring's rim against the foe's blade to ring a sharp note that jars his hand.

name: Caromhavoc
description: Release two rings into a squall so they scatter in the gusts and force the foe to dodge twice.

name: Nimbusbounce
description: Cast the ring so the gale bends its flight in a great curve around an obstacle onto the mark.

name: Aegis Disk
description: Keep rings whirling in a squall's pattern before the body so arrows and thrown blades are beaten down.

name: Grazehavoc
description: Let a full gale seize the thrown ring and carry it through every foe along its path.

name: Nimbus Innergrip
description: Survey the open ground for slopes and gusts before choosing where the first ring will fall.

name: Adamantine Holeedge
description: Stand wide with the ring guard moving in all directions as if no cover stood anywhere near.

name: Rumblebounce
description: Drive the wind-side shoulder forward and hurl the ring along the line of the gust.

name: Hoopvortex
description: Pace the bare plateau on the balls of the feet so the ground is felt through each step.

name: Radiant Bladering
description: Hold a spinning ring flat on the palm and let moving air lift its speed.

name: Gusthoop
description: Cast the ring in a wide open arc that no cover on the near side can stop.

name: Gust Outerblade
description: Fall back a step as the blade comes and use the ring to sweep it past the chest.

name: Diskscourge
description: Let the wind take the ring past the foe and swing it back against his unguarded rear.

name: Bounce Mettle
description: Hook the ring's rim behind a foe's knee and pull so his stance gives way.

name: Facet Ringface
description: Keep several rings in wide orbits about the body on open ground so no side lies bare.

name: Hellish Graze
description: Throw a ring in a sweeping line so the gale's push carries its edge through several foes.

name: Gyve Graze
description: Cast a ring so its rim snags a foe's ankle at a run and brings him down.

name: Bounce Devastation
description: Throw the last ring with the whole body and the wind behind it to punch through a heavily guarded foe.

name: Equipoise Fingerhole
description: Count slow breaths to the rhythm of the wind and hold the chosen bearing unchanged.

name: Auraround
description: Pitch the ring from the windward side so it leaves already leaning into its curve.

name: Aura Disk
description: Slip a spare ring over the wrist as a cuff and use it to take a glancing cut.

name: Ferocious Whirlcut
description: Shift the held bearing by a hand's breadth mid-throw so the foe's dodge fails.

name: Aura Ricochet
description: Slip through the gap a gust opens in a foe's guard and cut as you pass.

name: Murk Outerblade
description: Turn to the leeward side and take the blow on the ring's rim with the gust at the back.

name: Roundscourge
description: Throw rings down one held bearing so each follows the last into the same widening wound.

name: Deed Holeedge
description: Leave a ring spinning in a gust across the foe's route so it cuts at him when he comes.

name: Glint Gyrate
description: Break the bearing and reappear along another in a gust to pass the foe and cut as he turns.

name: Revitalizing Roundedge
description: Fall back on the old plain grip of the first lessons and feel the ring settle into it.

name: Whirlcut Devastation
description: Pitch the ring slowly and surely along the sworn line with no wasted motion.

name: Granite Innergrip
description: Turn the back to the wind and hold the ring over the shoulder against a blow from behind.

name: Might Graze
description: Cover ground in a long unhurried stride that keeps the ring hand steady and ready.

name: Bouncehavoc
description: Draw the ring's edge across the foe's guard in one steady pull that opens it.

name: Vessel Whirlcut
description: Hold the breath through the wind-up and release the ring only as the lungs empty.

name: Unbudging Ringface
description: Tilt the ring against a descending blade and let the gale's push finish the turn.

name: Novagyrate
description: Throw with the settled weight of the whole body so the ring bites deep through a braced guard.

name: Thorngraze
description: Throw after a fleeing foe so the wind wraps the ring's rim around his weapon arm.

name: Disk Wrath
description: Spend the whole reserve in one cast so the ring cuts through a guard no lesser throw could breach.
